task_revision_note: The current wording explicitly names the animation, composition and TTS tools and expands the existing deliverable list. The Astra run used v6.5; no capability, scoring criterion or answer was added in v6.5.1.

confirmed_issue_summary: Dense numeric and formula passages repeatedly lack functional pauses.
Questions, causal relations, contrasts and negations are often under-emphasized.
P/Q labels and several key phrases are not consistently easy to distinguish.
The listening examples enter and end abruptly.
strict_audio_review.scoring_note: Each dimension used a 0-4 integer level mapped to 0, 2.5, 5, 7.5 or 10 points. Three scores of 5 indicate the same broad level, not exact continuous measurement.
strict_audio_review.reliability_note: The first strict call incorrectly returned unknown despite consuming 807 audio tokens. A second call with the identical audio hash produced the scored review. ASR confusion around Q labels and closing terminology supports some clarity concerns, but the result remains an AI judgment.
